Question: What do corals provide to their symbiotic algae?
Sentence: Although some corals are able to catch plankton and small fish using stinging cells on their tentacles, most corals obtain the majority of their energy and nutrients from photosynthesis of symbiotic unicellular dinoflagellates of the genus Symbiodinium, which live within coral tissues.
